notes.title: Over 150% funded and we just crossed the 1000 follower mark!
notes.content: [p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/houndedgame/hounded"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/houndedgame/hounded[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]This is an update for our [b]silent supporters[/b]! Right now, [b]1,004[/b] people are [b]following[/b] Hounded, but over [b]750[/b] of you haven't backed yet.[/p][p][/p][p]We massively [b]appreciate[/b] your interest, but here's why [b]now[/b] is the time to jump in:[/p][p][/p][p][b]150%[/b] Funding[/p][p]The campaign is already a [b]success,[/b] so now any pledges that you make contribute to [b]unlocking[/b] stretch goals and making Hounded an even [b]better[/b] experience.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Only 13 days left[/b][/p][p]Once the campaign ends the exclusive rewards will be [b]gone[/b].   You don't want to miss out on [b]digital bundles[/b], physical Hounded [b]merch[/b], and the opportunity to help shape the world by creating your own [b]Imprint side-quests[/b].   And remember, [b]Kickstarter wont take any money until the campaign ends[/b], so if you are waiting for pay day, don't let that make you [b]miss out[/b] on a limited tier![/p][p][/p][p][b]Join a community[/b][/p][p]The Hounded discord is[b] live[/b] and full of our awesome backers. It is a super [b]friendly[/b] atmosphere with people posting pictures of their [b]pets[/b] all the time! It is also a place for you to [b]talk to the team[/b] directly and ask questions about Hounded.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Referral Challenge[/b][/p][p]This optional challenge is running on our [b]Discord[/b], and for [b]sharing[/b] the campaign with your friends, family or community, you could win a [b]games console[/b] of your choice or a [b]steam gift card[/b]!   If you are ready to back us, click "[b]Back This Project[/b]" or "[b]Manage Your Pledge[/b]" at the top of the page.[/p][p]Let's head into the second half of this campaign with [b]you[/b] in the pack![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646366/67e6793a8a1bb7659910570903d89ffb17425977.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Hounded Kickstarter reaches 100% funding in less than 4 days!
notes.content:
[p]Our Kickstarter campaign reached [b]100%[/b] in under 4 days thanks to our [b]incredible backers.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646366/e555002f1c8d779a119780225b4dba476f636f2a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We are already well on our way to reaching our first [b]stretch[/b] goal of adding [b]customisable[/b] collars and fur colours into the game![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646366/2010291675e4588f93b9d1e3b584f54c62670f56.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Some of our reward tiers are sold out, but we have just added some new ones, so if you haven't backed yet but would like to join us on this journey, please take a look here:[/p][p][/p][p][b][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/houndedgame/hounded/"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/houndedgame/hounded/[/url][/b]

Thanks,[/p][p][/p][p]The IMPRNT Team.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
